elements.description: Text filled with a slowly flowing liquid gradient, swept in from the left when it is first seen.

properties.name: content
properties.description: Rich content instead of `text`: an element that's cloned for the text and for its gradient copy

properties.name: colors
properties.description: Gradient start, end and up to two blob colours: [start, end, blob, blob]

properties.name: playFor
properties.description:
Seconds the flow runs before it rests (on the nearest quarter cycle below); Infinity never stops – then give
users a way to pause it (WCAG 2.2.2)

properties.name: sweep
properties.description: Sweep the colour in from left to right when the text scrolls into view (attribute: sweep="false" turns it off)

properties.name: as
properties.description: What the text is: inline text, a paragraph or a heading (h1, h2: the host becomes a heading of that level)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

props.name: children
props.description: The text – a string, or rich content that is cloned for the text and its gradient copy
